rooms.1: A plain 1980s corporate office of a sinister defence company: pale blue walls, fluorescent ceiling panels, a white door on the right, a staircase opening going down in the floor at the left, a bare white table in the middle.
rooms.2: A basement laboratory: a long counter with a sink and glassware along the left wall, shelves of chemicals behind glass doors, a wooden staircase climbing up the right side, a large metal mixing vat.
rooms.3: A small-town street corner in the 1980s: a road running straight toward a snow-capped green mountain, a low modern office building on the right with a blank sign, a gas station with a round sign on the left, clouds in a blue sky.
rooms.4: A street corner where a road runs straight toward a snow-capped green mountain, a low flat-roofed hardware store on the left, green hills either side, clouds in a blue sky.
rooms.5: A highway access ramp: a concrete overpass bridge spanning green hills, striped barricades, a curving black road with white lines.
rooms.6: A quiet suburban avenue through open grassy fields under a big blue sky with puffy white clouds, low green hills on the horizon.
rooms.8: A small 1980s gas station: a green clapboard station building with windows and a door, two old fuel pumps on a concrete island in front, a canopy overhead.
rooms.9: Inside a gas station cashier's booth: a counter with an old adding machine, a window looking out at the pumps, a pile of crumpled trash on the floor.
rooms.11: A field of tall green grass with a wooden post-and-wire fence across it, gentle hills, clouds in a blue sky.
rooms.12: A freeway running over rolling green hills: two black lanes with white dashed lines vanishing to the horizon, a road sign on a post (no lettering), clouds in a blue sky.
rooms.13: A cramped shed full of radio equipment: racks of old ham radio sets with dials and meters along the back wall, a workbench, windows showing the yard outside.
rooms.14: A dark mine shaft: a timbered tunnel entrance lit by a flashlight beam, rough brown rock all around, a heavy stone door half-hidden in the gloom.
rooms.15: The cul-de-sac at the end of a suburban avenue: a round turning circle of black asphalt in green lawns, clouds in a blue sky.
rooms.16: The long living room of a large suburban house in one-point perspective: pale walls, a hallway leading back to a far window, a polished floor.
rooms.17: Inside a 1980s hardware store: a long service counter in the foreground, shelves and windows along the back wall, a cash register.
rooms.18: The east end of an empty parking lot: black asphalt with white parking lines, a green wooded mountainside rising behind.
rooms.19: The west end of an empty parking lot: black asphalt with white painted lines, a strip of sea or lake on the horizon, a green hill at the right edge.
rooms.20: A beach by a lake: a white lifeguard tower on stilts with a red-cross flag on a pole, white sand, a forested mountain rising on the right, blue sky.
rooms.21: A cold shallow mountain lake: clear blue water fed by a waterfall tumbling down a green, forested rocky slope, rocks in the water.
rooms.22: The foot of a mountain: a towering wall of green, mossy, jagged rock on the right, clouds in a blue sky on the left.
rooms.23: A small ledge high on a mountainside of green, mossy, jagged rock, a steep drop below.
rooms.24: A cavern inside a mountain: walls of green-lit jagged rock, a tall white cylindrical bomb casing standing in the middle on the cavern floor, an old jeep parked in the shadows at the left.
rooms.25: Inside a lifeguard shack: a wide window looking out over the lake and a green mountain, a plain counter beneath the window, wooden walls.
rooms.26: The garage of a large suburban house in perspective: white walls, a long empty workbench with shelves along the back, a bare light bulb, an open garage door behind.
rooms.28: Behind a mountain: a road winding past a great wall of green, mossy, jagged rock filling the view.
rooms.29: The cockpit of an experimental rocket-powered jet car: a futuristic dashboard with dials and switches, a steering wheel, a canopy frame, a long straight desert road ahead.
rooms.35: The hereafter: billowing white clouds on the left with a winged angel holding a golden harp, and on the right a red-skinned devil with a pitchfork among flames.

items.4: A large clear quartz crystal, many-faceted.
items.5: A small wooden garden shed with a tall radio antenna mast on its roof.
items.6: A large two-storey suburban house with a pitched roof, front porch and windows.
items.7: A small red metal toolbox with a handle.
items.19: An old, grimy car battery with two terminals.
items.23: A climber's ice pick with a steel head and leather-wrapped handle.
items.25: An old battery hydrometer: a glass tube with a rubber bulb on top.
items.26: A manual hand pump for fuel, with a crank handle and a hose.
items.27: A sleek experimental rocket-powered jet car, low and long, with a big jet engine at the back and tail fins.
items.30: A small vintage ham radio transceiver with dials, meters and a microphone.
items.34: A large dark hole in the ground with rough broken edges, seen from slightly above.
items.35: Another large dark hole in rocky ground with rough broken edges, seen from slightly above.
items.37: A black telephone line dangling straight down, as if from a pole above (the top cut off), its frayed end loose.
items.51: A pair of heavy automotive jumper cables with red and black clamps, loosely coiled.
